description: This file defines a ResultSet class for 'Dish' in a database schema, including methods for creating dishes from recipes, summing servings, filtering by date, and deleting related items.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::Dish
classes.description: A ResultSet class for handling 'Dish' records in the database, providing methods for creating dishes from recipes, aggregating data, filtering by date, and cleanup.

methods.name: from_recipe
methods.description: Creates a new Dish record based on a given recipe, copying attributes, tags, and ingredients, and associating purchase lists if applicable.

methods.name: sum_servings
methods.description: Calculates the total number of servings across the dishes in the result set.

methods.name: in_past_or_today
methods.description: Filters dishes associated with meals scheduled on or before today.

methods.name: in_future
methods.description: Filters dishes associated with meals scheduled after today.

methods.name: delete_update_items
methods.description: Deletes or updates related items for each dish in the result set within a transaction.
